import "date"
import "timezone"

option location = timezone.location(name: "UTC")

from(bucket: "enphase")
  |> range(start: 2024-10-01T00:00:00Z, stop: 2026-05-01T00:00:00Z)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "enphase_history_15m" and (r._field == "energy_produced_wh" or r._field == "energy_consumed_wh" or r._field == "exported_to_grid_wh" or r._field == "imported_from_grid_wh"))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) / 1000.0 }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with season: if date.month(t: r._time) == 12 or date.month(t: r._time) <= 2 then "Summer" else if date.month(t: r._time) >= 3 and date.month(t: r._time) <= 5 then "Autumn" else if date.month(t: r._time) >= 6 and date.month(t: r._time) <= 8 then "Winter" else "Spring" }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.season == "Summer")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: if r._field == "energy_produced_wh" then "Produced" else if r._field == "energy_consumed_wh" then "Consumed" else if r._field == "exported_to_grid_wh" then "Exported" else "Imported" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_field", "_value"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: [], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

targets.query:
import "date"
import "timezone"

option location = timezone.location(name: "UTC")

from(bucket: "enphase")
  |> range(start: 2024-10-01T00:00:00Z, stop: 2026-05-01T00:00:00Z)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "enphase_history_15m" and (r._field == "energy_produced_wh" or r._field == "energy_consumed_wh" or r._field == "exported_to_grid_wh" or r._field == "imported_from_grid_wh"))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) / 1000.0, hour_number: date.hour(t: r._time) }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with Hour: if r.hour_number < 10 then "0" + string(v: r.hour_number) + ":00" else string(v: r.hour_number) + ":00" }))
  |> group(columns: ["hour_number", "Hour", "_field"])
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: if r._field == "energy_produced_wh" then "Produced" else if r._field == "energy_consumed_wh" then "Consumed" else if r._field == "exported_to_grid_wh" then "Exported" else "Imported" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["hour_number", "Hour", "_field", "_value"])
  |> group(columns: ["hour_number", "Hour"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["hour_number", "Hour"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["hour_number"])
  |> drop(columns: ["hour_number"])
